long_description: A middle-aged sea captain with a rich, booming voice and a British accent. He speaks and sings with big, warm energy, leading his crew with a full, rounded sound. Halloween.

name: Playful Unicycle
long_description: A middle-aged clown with a mid, rounded and slightly rough voice that he stretches and bends for laughs. He talks slowly and unevenly, drawing out his vowels as if he's always a little confused, then breaks into a goofy chuckle. Halloween.

name: Stately Chandelier
long_description: An older lady ghost with a rich, resonant voice and crisp, refined British diction. She speaks slowly and theatrically, letting her voice rise and fall with dramatic pauses, warm and playful with a hint of mischief. Halloween.  Spooky. Scary.

name: Charming Key
description: Masculine, British, Very deep, Grave Keeper
long_description: An older gentleman host with an extremely deep, resonant voice and crisp, refined British diction. He speaks in an unhurried, theatrical way, with dramatic pauses and a playful, spooky smile in his tone. Halloween. Spooky. Scary.
